ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-5, Neighborhood
Shopping District; C1-5, Neighborhood Commercial Districts; T, Transportation District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 13-G in the area bounded by:

      West Bryn Mawr Avenue; the alley next east of and parallel to North Winthrop Avenue; a line 200 feet
      south of and parallel to West Bryn Mawr Avenue; North Winthrop Avenue; a line 110 feet south of and
      parallel to Bryn Mawr Avenue, the alley next south of and parallel to West Bryn Mawr Avenue; and the
      east right-of-way line of the Paradise and Pacific Railroad,

to those of a B3-5, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.



                                                        ____________________________
                                                        Leni Manaa-Hoppenworth
                                                        Alderwoman, 48th Ward




Common Addresses:
1069-1113 W. Bryn Mawr Avenue
